promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.explain: 'Das Gepäck' means 'the luggage/baggage'.
'Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel' means 'public transport'. A traffic jam is 'der Stau'.
'Der Müll' means 'rubbish/waste'. 'Müll trennen' = 'to separate the rubbish (for recycling)'.
'Die Wohnung' means 'the flat/apartment'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Turn left at the traffic lights'?
options: Biegen Sie an der Ampel links ab
Gehen Sie an der Ampel geradeaus
Biegen Sie an der Ampel rechts ab
Biegen Sie an der Ecke links ab
questions.explain: 'Links abbiegen' = 'turn left' and 'die Ampel' = 'the traffic lights'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I always turn off the light'?
options: Ich mache das Licht immer an
Ich mache das Licht nie aus
Ich mache die Tür immer zu
Ich mache das Licht immer aus
questions.explain: 'Ausmachen' = 'to turn off' and 'immer' = 'always'; 'anmachen' (turn on) is the trap.
'Die Reise' means 'the journey/trip'; 'der Reis' (rice) is the near-miss.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I separate the rubbish for recycling'?
options: Ich trenne den Müll zum Recycling
questions.explain: 'Trennen' = 'to separate/sort' and 'zum Recycling' = 'for recycling'.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: I will live in the city
I used to live in the city
I rarely live in the city
At the moment I live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
'In der Nähe' means 'nearby/close by', e.g. 'in der Nähe der Schule' = 'near the school'.
'Die Luftverschmutzung' means 'air pollution' (Luft = air + Verschmutzung = pollution).

questions.q: How do you say 'My town is too noisy'?
questions.explain: 'Laut' means 'loud/noisy'; 'ruhig' (quiet) is the opposite distractor.
'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.

questions.q: How do you say 'The weather is getting warmer'?
questions.explain: 'Wird wärmer' = 'is getting warmer'; 'kälter' (colder) is the trap.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'It is raining heavily today'?
questions.explain: 'Es regnet' = 'it is raining' and 'stark' = 'heavily'; 'schneit' (snows) is the trap.
'Der Umweltschutz' means 'environmental protection' (Umwelt + Schutz).
'Die Überschwemmung' means 'the flood/flooding'.
'Das Ausland' means 'abroad/foreign countries'; 'im Ausland' = abroad.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'There is no cinema in my village'?
options: In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Kino
In meinem Dorf gibt es ein Kino
In meinem Dorf gibt es kein Kino
questions.explain: 'Das Dorf' = 'village', 'kein Kino' = 'no cinema', 'es gibt' = 'there is'.
'Die Verpackung' means 'the packaging' (wrapping that often becomes waste).
'Die Freizeit' means 'free time / leisure time'.
'Die Unterkunft' means 'accommodation'. 'Food' is 'das Essen'.
